**MyDesk for Windows**

Download `MyDesk-Setup-x.y.z.exe` below and double-click it to install. It replaces the older version.

What's new in 1.2.0:
- **Updates itself from now on:** when a new version is out, MyDesk shows a pop-up. Click **Download and install** and it downloads, reinstalls and restarts on its own. (Install this version by hand once; later ones arrive through the pop-up.)
- **Desktop app settings** (Profile & preferences → Desktop app): open MyDesk when Windows starts, turn desktop notifications on or off, and check for updates.
- **Notification pop-ups** use the MyDesk icon on its purple tile, so they're easy to spot.
- **Publisher details:** Alif Mahmud · info@alifmahmud.com · alifmahmud.com.

Still the same: it opens the live MyDesk site, so new features arrive without reinstalling. Press `Ctrl+R` to reload.

If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the installer isn't code-signed yet).
